about: The heading of a reading from the prophet Isaiah. It names the prophet rather than his book. The 1962 Roman Missal prints it over the Epistles of the Epiphany of the Lord, of the Commemoration of the Baptism of Our Lord Jesus Christ, of the Annunciation of the Blessed Virgin Mary and of the Nativity of Saint John the Baptist.

seg.tr: A reading from Isaiah the Prophet
